case.title: Pinned technician columns after deactivation or removal from this location
case.custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A}, an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • A second user {User-B} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST C368131 Viewer") has a role with Work orders > View only (Create & Edit off) at {Location-A} and is signed in in a second browser or a private window.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example Esther Howard) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Jenny Pinned) is an active technician at {Location-A}, made for this case only, and leads no work order.
  • Technician {Technician-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Theresa Pinned) is an active technician whose Location (Settings > Staff) is {Location-A}, made for this case only. {Location-B} is another location of the company (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310).
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST C368131 Pinned Gone") is used by this case only.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17691) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A}.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17692) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-C}.
  • Both {User-A} and {User-B} have {Technician-B} and {Technician-C} pinned in Board View.
  • No technician has a shift on the Schedule for {Work-order-1} or {Work-order-2}.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is ticked in Status, Asset on Site shows no choice (if its chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.
case.custom_steps:
1. Click your initials (top right) and open Settings > Staff.
  2. Click {Technician-B}'s edit icon, click Deactivate Account and confirm.
  3. Click {Technician-C}'s edit icon, change her Location from {Location-A} to {Location-B} and click Save & Close.
  4. Click Work Orders in the top menu.
  5. Click the All tab, click Search and type the name of {Customer-A}.
  6. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  7. Read the pinned columns right after Unassigned, including {Technician-B}'s column.
  8. Find {Technician-C}'s column further along and read its header.
  9. Drag {Work-order-1} from {Technician-A}'s column onto {Technician-B}'s column and let go.
  10. Drag {Work-order-1} from {Technician-A}'s column onto {Technician-C}'s column and let go.
  11. Read the message that appears and where {Work-order-1} is.
  12. Drag {Work-order-2} from {Technician-C}'s column onto the Unassigned column and let go.
  13. Read which column {Work-order-2} is in and whether {Technician-C} still has a column.
  14. In the second browser, as {User-B}, open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Board View.
  15. Read the pinned columns right after Unassigned, including {Technician-B}'s column.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: {Technician-B}'s column is still shown right after Unassigned, so the pin is kept. It is marked inactive and empty, and it reads "No work orders", not "Drag a work order here to assign it".
  • Step 7: {Technician-C} is not among the pinned columns.
  • Step 8: {Technician-C}'s column appears further along as a normal column holding {Work-order-2}, with no pin icon and no inactive marker.
  • Step 9: the card cannot be dropped on {Technician-B}'s column. {Work-order-1} stays in {Technician-A}'s column.
  • Steps 10 and 11: the drop is refused with the message "This technician can't be assigned work orders." and {Work-order-1} stays in {Technician-A}'s column.
  • Step 13: {Work-order-2} is in Unassigned and {Technician-C} no longer has a column at all.
  • Step 15: for the view-only {User-B}, {Technician-B}'s column also reads "No work orders", and there is no {Technician-C} column.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View — board by lead technician) and SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 49 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S3-R20a, S3-E3, S3-N4, S3-R20b and its context note (Sasha Grosman's answer to SQ-11, 24 Sep 2026), S3-R20c (added in version 49) and S4-N5 (widened in version 49), both from Chris Ward's answer 2 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; read 14 Oct 2026. Sasha Grosman's answer to engineering of 24 Sep 2026 treated a technician who is no longer at this location like an inactive one; PRD version 49 (14 Oct 2026) says that column shows no inactive marker and refuses drops with its own message, and we take the later PRD as prevailing. Source-verified 14 October 2026. This version of the case has not yet been checked against a build (the previous version, updated 9 Oct 2026 for PRD v44, was not re-run on the QA build).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R20a: “The empty column of a pinned technician who has been deactivated shows “No work orders” to every user, because nothing can be dropped there (S4-N5).”
  • S3-E3: “Retain a technician’s pin after deactivation.”
  • S3-N4: “Show an inactive indicator on deactivated technician columns.”
  • S3-R20b: “A pinned technician who is not enrolled at this location gets no column here. If they still lead work orders at this location, they appear as a normal, unpinned column holding that work.”
  • S3-R20c: “The column of S3-R20b takes no drops. Dropping a work order on it is refused with "This technician can't be assigned work orders." and the work order stays where it was. The column shows no inactive marker, because the technician is not deactivated (S3-N4). Once it holds no work orders, the column is no longer shown.”
  • S4-N5: “Nothing can be dropped onto the column/group of an inactive technician (S2-N2, S3-N2) or of a technician who is not enrolled at this location (S3-R20c).”
  • Context note (S3-R20a, S3-R20b): “A pin only counts at locations where the technician is enrolled.”

Last checked against build v26.40.17-ddb9ba1 (staging) on 10/14/2026.
